patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: Cut my hand on the pruning shears
presentation.quote: I have four hundred hours of virtual farming and my first real tomato plant put me in the ER. The irony is not lost on me. It's pretty deep and it was very muddy soil.
presentation.triageNote: 23-year-old female with a deep soil-contaminated laceration to the palm from pruning shears two hours ago; bleeding is controlled with intact tendon function and neurovascular exam, tetanus status unknown.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this stable contaminated palm wound requires one resource for extensive irrigation, exploration, and closure.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a deep soil-contaminated hand laceration with intact tendon and neurovascular function.
clinical.acuityReason: This stable contaminated palm wound requires one resource for extensive irrigation, exploration, and closure.
teachingPoints: A garden wound is a dirty wound: explore for grit and plant material, irrigate generously, and check tetanus status — 'unknown' means give it. Always test tendon function BEFORE anaesthetising the hand.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleDiagnoses: Retained plant or soil foreign material
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Thorough cleansing and repair, tetanus prophylaxis, and wound precautions would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 23-year-old woman in a Stardew Valley t-shirt and muddy gardening gloves pushed down at the wrists, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting holding her right hand palm-up in her lap, a gauze pad pressed against the palm
signs: a gauze pad held against the palm of one hand
muddy gardening gloves pushed down around the wrists
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 23-year-old woman in a Stardew Valley t-shirt and muddy gardening gloves pushed down at the wrists, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting holding her right hand palm-up in her lap, a gauze pad pressed against the palm. Expression: rueful and self-deprecating. Clearly visible: a gauze pad held against the palm of one hand; muddy gardening gloves pushed down around the wrists; soil on the forearms. Overall: entirely well, cut hand. The only lettering anywhere in the picture is the words 'STARDEW VALLEY' printed cleanly across the front of the t-shirt. No other text, no watermarks, no border.
